intents.action: Sword-and-shield infantry makes a short forceful forward sword thrust toward RIGHT. Step forward, bend front knee, turn shoulders and fully extend sword hand while bracing the SAME blue wooden shield near torso; sword below helmet height. A real committed strike, not a resting sword held down.

Armored sword-and-shield veteran makes a powerful low horizontal sword cut toward RIGHT, front knee bent and body twisting, SAME broad shield held close to guard the chest. Preserve winged helmet, larger armor and cloak. Sword below helmet height and inside canvas; a clear cut rather than idle.

The SAME FEMALE human scout, NO bird, leans forward and SHOOTS the wooden-stock crossbow toward RIGHT. Both arms extend the weapon at shoulder height, cheek aligned behind stock, bowstring visibly released and one small actual bolt just departing. Step forward and bend knee; torso/arms clearly differ from resting waist-height crossbow.

The SAME FEMALE armored ranger, NO bird, fires the SAME reinforced crossbow toward RIGHT. Raised shoulder-height aim, cheek behind stock, both hands on weapon, released string and one small departing bolt; front knee bent and torso leaning into the shot. Preserve helmet/cuirass/armor and enlarged real crest.

The SAME mail-clad human polearm soldier makes a committed forward HALBERD THRUST toward RIGHT, both hands driving the existing polearm horizontally at chest height, shoulders twisting, front knee bent and rear foot grounded. Preserve ordinary helmet/mail, navy cloth and official crest. Entire polearm fits; no shield, dragon, spell, firearm or new weapon.

The SAME heavily armored human Dragonguard thrusts the reinforced HALBERD toward RIGHT using both hands, front knee bent, body leaning forward and rear foot grounded. Preserve winged closed helmet, layered armor, scaled dark drake-hide mantle, navy tabard, exact larger polearm and official crest. Whole weapon inside frame; no shield, dragon companion, fire spell or mere idle stance.

The SAME female fencer makes a genuine deep fencing LUNGE toward RIGHT: forward knee bent, rear leg extended, rapier arm straight at chest height, free arm swept backward for balance. Preserve original rapier, unarmored base outfit, head/face/hair and enlarged real crest. The point must fully fit, no duplicate blades or idle fencing guard.

The SAME upgraded female fencer performs a committed rapier THRUST toward RIGHT with straight sword arm, low forward knee, extended rear leg and free hand pulled back. Preserve upgrade helmet/plume/face, armor, cape, rapier and enlarged crest. Entire blade must fit; no additional swords, spell or mere resting stance.

The SAME brown-braided battle musician releases a resonant RANGED strike toward RIGHT from her strapped wooden hammered dulcimer. Lean into the action with bent front knee and shifted torso; one hand has just struck the strings with its wooden beater while the other is raised to strike. One SMALL pale-gold joined musical note leaves the instrument toward RIGHT, not a giant spell circle. Preserve cloth outfit, two beaters, physical straps and official crest; this must differ clearly from both beaters resting over strings.

The SAME brown-braided armored musician attacks toward RIGHT by forcefully striking the SAME strapped reinforced dulcimer: lean forward, step and bend front knee, one wooden beater contacts strings while the other is visibly raised, a SMALL pale-gold musical note leaves toward RIGHT. Preserve steel armor, blue cloak, two beaters, larger instrument and actual crest. No floating instrument, sword, shield, new spell circle or idle pose.

The SAME hooded masked MELEE soldier makes a genuine forward suppression-baton strike toward RIGHT. Bend front knee and twist torso; extend short pale baton firmly at enemy chest height while other hand keeps closed codex near belt. Preserve the lighter navy coat and official crest. No crossbow, gun, projectile, magic ray or returned idle baton-down pose.

The SAME armored masked MELEE Inquisitor forcefully THRUSTS the long squared petricite suppression pole toward RIGHT using BOTH hands. Lean into bent front knee, extend weapon horizontally and keep rear foot grounded. Preserve broad cowl/collar, heavy cloak, plated legs, closed codex and official crests. Entire pole must fit canvas. No gun, missile or magical casting gesture.

The SAME grounded petricite stone construct makes a massive forward PUNCH toward RIGHT, one fist extended with bent elbow pushing out, opposite fist drawn back to ribs, torso rotating and one huge stone foot stepping forward. Keep BOTH feet grounded, original unawakened rough stone slabs, small blue cloth and real chest crest. No wings, flight, weapon, magic beam or merely two fists hanging idle.

The SAME upgraded grounded petricite construct makes a heavy forward PUNCH toward RIGHT: step forward, rotate torso, drive one massive fist outward and draw other fist back to guard. Preserve the angular winglike shoulder plates, armored gold/petricite slabs, blue cloth and large real crest. No actual wings/flight, new weapon, spell blast or static idle; keep giant feet grounded.
